messages.subject: Project Quartz — mutual NDA
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Mr Velloran,

Further to Daniel Reston's introduction, please find attached the mutual non-disclosure agreement for the proposed transaction. It is in standard form (two-year term, mutual undertakings, 12-month non-solicit). If acceptable, please arrange signature and we can begin sharing information.

Kind regards,
James Osei
Whitfield Carter LLP
